svg.title: Major second (M2): information sheet, phone layout
svg.desc: Major second, M2: C4 to D4, 2 semitones. A keyboard from C4 to C5 with both keys highlighted in this interval's identity colour and 2 numbered semitone hops. Two time strips show the notes one after another and together. Plogger [2] lens: Dissonant family (jagged), ← Fundamental, Harmonic (Plogger), open/light.

g.text: 2 letter names counted inclusively (C to D)
HOW TO READ THE THREE PLOGGER MARKS
perfect-group family. A family label, not a
A historic teaching lens from the archived
acoustic law. The identity colour is a separate,
Root C4 stays; upper note D4→D♭4, one key
apart. Plogger: A same, B same, C changes.
Root C4 stays; upper note D4→E♭4, one key
apart. Plogger: A changes, B same, C changes.
How to read: find C4 on your keyboard, then
count 2 semitones up (every key, white or
black, is one step) to D4. The numbered arcs
are those steps. Top left shows the two
notes one after another, top right the same
